title: The $100 Massage That Costs About $20 in China | China Travel Expert
description:
A one-hour massage that runs $80–120 in New York or London costs about 150 yuan in China — roughly $20, four to six times cheaper.

That's the going rate across most Chinese cities: a quality one-hour foot reflexology or full-body tuina session is usually ¥100–200 (about $15–28), with walk-in parlours on nearly every block. Tipping isn't expected — the number on the board is what you pay — so a daily massage on a China trip can genuinely cost less than a single session back home. Five-star hotel spas charge far more (¥500–1,200+), which is exactly why locals skip them.

🧭 Expert Tip: choose a busy neighbourhood shop over a hotel spa — same skill, a fraction of the price. Point at the menu board if the staff don't speak English; most places have one.

在纽约按摩一小时要 80～120 美元，在中国大概 150 元（约 20 美元）——便宜四到六倍，还不用给小费。
